## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A 9-juan Late-Míng military training manual by Qī Jìguāng, composed during his northern-frontier command (1568–1582) at Jìzhèn 薊鎮 — the strategic command guarding the eastern approaches to Beijing. The work parallels and extends Qī's earlier *Jì xiào xīn shū* ([KR3b0019](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR3/KR3b/KR3b0019)), with extensive adaptation for cavalry-and-firearms warfare appropriate to the northern frontier (versus the infantry-centric Zhè-Mǐn coastal context of the earlier work). Composition: bracketed by Qī's Jìzhèn tenure (1568–1582). The frontmatter brackets to 1568–1582.

**Abstract**

The *Liàn bīng shí jì* is Qī's mature military-doctrinal work, complementing the earlier *Jì xiào xīn shū* with the northern-frontier perspective. Together the two works are the principal Late-Míng military-doctrinal corpus.

The bibliographic record: *Míng shǐ yìwén zhì*; SKQS *Zǐbù — Bīngjiā lèi*.
